correctness.rationale: Under the determinant-one Haar change (u,v)=(x,2x+y), the observations are s of the integer forms (1,0),(0,1),(-1,3),(-3,8),(-8,21). Global inversion kills odd Walsh moments, the nonzero determinants of every pair kill two-point moments, and half-lattice translations kill all four-point moments except indices 0,1,3,4. Independently reconstructed exact Fraction polygon clipping partitions the unit square into 168 positive-area five-sign polygons and into 156 four-form polygons; all 32 word masses equal [1+(epsilon_0 epsilon_1 epsilon_3 epsilon_4)/21]/32, and the exceptional fourth moment is 1/21. Both consecutive four-block marginals are exactly fair independent. The finite partition is an exhaustive exact integral certificate because every intersecting rational strip is included, not a Monte Carlo sample. Walsh inversion and Haar invariance establish the probabilistic claim.
